news.title: ACE, COE Warn Proposed TRIO Changes Would Undermine Decades of College Access Success
news.summary_en: ACE and the Council for Opportunity in Education sent a joint letter to the departments of Education and Labor last week, raising concerns about proposed changes to the TRIO Talent Search and Educational Opportunity Centers competitions.

news.title: Higher Ed Groups Warn OMB Rule Would Shift Grant Decisions From Merit to Politics
news.summary_en: ACE and 48 other higher education associations have submitted formal comments opposing a proposed federal rule that would significantly expand political appointees' control over the awarding, administration, and termination of federal grants.
